title: Politieke participatie Nederland 1971
descriptions: Political participation in the Netherlands. A set of core questions was designed to ascertain political participation Background variables: basic characteristics/ place of birth/ residence/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ place of work/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ social class/ politics/ religion/ consumption of durables/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure/ organizational membership
